visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting a courtroom scene. A central figure in 18th-century style clothing stands and holds up a small, dark object, possibly a piece of fabric or a shoe, for the court to see. A judge sits on an elevated bench to the left. Other figures, including men in suits and a woman, are seated or standing in the courtroom. A beam of light shines down from the upper left corner.

suggestedMatch.exactSourceQuotation: Mr. Fogg and his two companions took their places on a bench opposite the desks of the magistrate and his clerk. Immediately after, Judge Obadiah, a fat, round man, followed by the clerk, entered. He proceeded to take down a wig which was hanging on a nail and put it hurriedly on his head.
